mapper.select: SELECT u.nickname, u.profile_image, u.profile_source, sp.rank_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN soldier_profile sp ON sp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_withdrawn = FALSE

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN ib.badge_tier IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ib.safe_grade IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN ib.aggressive_grade IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) FROM investment_badge ib WHERE ib.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT badge_code FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('TIER_', badge_tier) AS badge_code, updated_at FROM investment_badge WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND badge_tier IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('SAFE_', safe_grade), updated_at FROM investment_badge WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND safe_grade IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('AGGRESSIVE_', aggressive_grade), updated_at FROM investment_badge WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND aggressive_grade IS NOT NULL ) badges ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET is_withdrawn = TRUE, withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_withdrawn = FALSE
